Fit Bayesian Ento-Trials model

fit_ento_model.Rd

High-level wrapper function to fit entomological hut trial data using Stan. Estimates intervention effects on mosquito behavior (Post and Pre-prandial killing efficacy, reduction in host availability, mortality during host seeking). Supports predefined models and custom Stan models.

Usage

fit_ento_model(
  data,
  model_type = "basic",
  custom_model = NULL,
  stan_data = NULL,
  iter = 6000,
  warmup = 3000,
  chains = 3,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.8),
  init = "auto",
  pars = NULL,
  prior_settings = NULL,
  output_path = NULL,
  save_y_rep = FALSE,
  seed = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

Data frame. Formatted data with endpoints and treatment column. Required columns depend on model_type (see list_available_models).

model_type

Character. Predefined model type: "basic" (default) or "semifield". Use list_available_models() to see available options. Ignored if custom_model is provided.

custom_model

Character or NULL. Path to custom Stan model file. If provided, overrides model_type.

stan_data

List or NULL. Pre-prepared Stan data list. If NULL, data is prepared automatically based on model_type.

iter

Integer. Total iterations per chain (default: 6000).

warmup

Integer. Warmup/burn-in iterations (default: 3000).

chains

Integer. Number of MCMC chains (default: 3).

control

List. Stan control parameters. See rstan::stan.

init

Character, function, or list. Initialization method. "auto" generates model-appropriate inits. Can also pass a function or list for custom initialization.

pars

Character vector. Parameters to save. If NULL, uses model defaults, or saves all quantities for a custom model.

prior_settings

List. Model-specific prior settings (for supported models).

output_path

Character. Path to save fitted model (.rds).

save_y_rep

Logical. If TRUE, also save the replicated data y_rep used by posterior_predictive_check (default: FALSE, as it can make the fit large).

seed

Integer. Random seed for reproducibility.

verbose

Logical. Print fitting progress? (default: TRUE)

...

Additional arguments passed to rstan::stan.

Value

A stanfit object with MCMC samples. Parameters depend on model:

Basic model:

  • PostprandialKilling: Post-feeding killing

  • PreprandialKilling: Pre-feeding killing

  • HostAvailabilityReduction: Reduction in host availability

  • KillingDuringHostSeeking: Mortality during approach, relative to the attack rate alpha_0

  • KillingDuringHostSeekingAbsolute: The same as an absolute additional mortality rate (alpha_0 * KillingDuringHostSeeking)

  • alpha_0, mu_0, pC_0: Baseline parameters (attack rate, mortality, blood-feeding survival)

Details

Predefined Models

Use model_type to select from predefined models:

  • "basic": Standard multinomial model for EHT data

  • "semifield": For matched semifield experiments with a spatial repellent (advanced)

Custom Stan Models

For custom models, provide path via custom_model parameter. You must also provide stan_data as a properly formatted list, or ensure your data has columns matching your model's requirements.

Custom Parameters

Use pars to specify which parameters to extract. For custom models, this should match your model's parameter block.

See also

list_available_models, prepare_stan_data, extract_stan_summary, extract_stan_posteriors

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Basic usage with default model
fit <- fit_ento_model(data = my_data)

# With custom Stan model and custom parameters
fit_custom <- fit_ento_model(
  data = my_data,
  custom_model = "path/to/my_model.stan",
  stan_data = my_custom_stan_list,
  pars = c("my_param1", "my_param2"),
  init = my_init_function
)

# Adjust MCMC settings
fit <- fit_ento_model(
  data = data,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12)
)
} # }
